$comment: sha256 of every DuckDB-WASM file the site serves. build_site refuses to ship a file that differs. Upgrade: change the version in package.json, npm install, then python -m pipeline.build_site --update-vendor-lock and review the diff. Extensions: DuckDB-WASM loads parquet as an extension; build_site downloads each listed file from extension_source, checks its sha256 and serves it from vendor/extensions.
